utterances.speaker: MR. ALARID
utterances.text: Your Honour, Miss -- are we in private session?

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: We are in open session, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: I was saying, Mr. Alarid, that the transcript will show that the explanation that you have given for the absence of a witness, and it's in the interest of the public that when witnesses are absent and there is no hearing that an explanation be given. In the circumstances, we will adjourn until tomorrow morning at 10 minutes to 9.00. It's occurring to me, though, Mr. Alarid, that -- and in the law experience that I've developed here that I might ask you about a reserve, a back-up witness. You ought to have had a planning in place that would have provided for a reserve or a back-up witness in the event that your primary witness was for, whatever reason, not able to attend.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Yes. So I was expecting that you'd have a full roster for the rest of the week.

utterances.speaker: MR. ALARID
utterances.text: Your Honour, absent to you allowing us to bring other people from -- where our amendments, my experts are all I have to bring, and we have one person with regards to the passport. But other than that, we're winding up, Your Honour, with the witnesses absent. The subpoenas that were absent until Friday, I mean, had those come a little sooner, we might have been able to secure two of those because they were willing witnesses but needed subpoenas for purposes of their positions. But that was one of the problems with the timing of those decisions, and I think the collateral ex parte matters that had been happening complicated our ability to do that.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: But you should be able to get some of those subpoenaed. You have until the --

utterances.speaker: MR. ALARID
utterances.text: I hope, so Judge, but we just got your decision Friday, so we didn't have the subpoenas issued until Friday.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: But in the circumstances, we are adjourned until tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Tuesday, the 17th day of March, 2009, at 8.50 a.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 8.59 a.m.,
